[
  {"step":1,"file":"src-vul/stb/stb_image.h","function":"stbi__process_frame_header","line":3157,"var":"c","code":"if (c != 3 && c != 1 && c != 4) return stbi__err(\"bad component count\",\"Corrupt JPEG\");","note":"The decoder permits 4-component JPEGs, enabling attacker-controlled CMYK decoding and the associated resampling code paths."},
  {"step":2,"file":"src-vul/stb/stb_image.h","function":"stbi__process_frame_header","line":3173,"var":"z->img_comp[i].h","code":"z->img_comp[i].h = (q >> 4);  if (!z->img_comp[i].h || z->img_comp[i].h > 4) return stbi__err(\"bad H\",\"Corrupt JPEG\");","note":"The horizontal sampling factor comes from the attacker-controlled SOF marker and is only bounded, not validated for a legal subsampling matrix."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src-vul/stb/stb_image.h","function":"stbi__process_frame_header","line":3184,"var":"v_max","code":"if (z->img_comp[i].v > v_max) v_max = z->img_comp[i].v;","note":"The decoder derives the overall vertical subsampling maximum from the crafted component table, propagating the attacker-chosen geometry into all later calculations."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src-vul/stb/stb_image.h","function":"stbi__process_frame_header","line":3212,"var":"z->img_comp[i].raw_data","code":"z->img_comp[i].raw_data = stbi__malloc_mad2(z->img_comp[i].w2, z->img_comp[i].h2, 15);","note":"Component buffers are allocated using dimensions derived from the malformed subsampling factors, so later upsampling works on attacker-shaped memory regions."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src-vul/stb/stb_image.h","function":"load_jpeg_image","line":3768,"var":"r->resample","code":"else if (r->hs == 2 && r->vs == 1) r->resample = z->resample_row_h_2_kernel;","note":"The malformed factors select a fixed horizontal-2 resampler rather than rejecting the nonstandard component layout."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src-vul/stb/stb_image.h","function":"stbi__resample_row_h_2","line":3345,"var":"out[i*2+1]","code":"out[i*2+1] = stbi__div4(3*in_near[i] + in_near[i+1] + 2);","note":"The horizontal 2x upsampler interpolates adjacent samples under standard JPEG assumptions; with mismatched component geometry it can read/write past the intended row extent."}
]
JSON
cat /workspace/candidate_trace.json
